Much of this equipment is often operated simultaneously but non-continuously. To estimate the sound level radiating offsite during mining, sound level data were obtained for this equipment while it was in operation. In addition to these mobile sound sources, sound level data were obtained for stationary sound sources such as the primary crusher, secondary crusher, conveyor belt and coal cars being loaded. A summary of these data is presented in Table II-14, which contains the statistical A-weighted sound level measured for the above mentioned mining equipment.
